mapper.select: SELECT so.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_no AS "orderNo", bp.partner_name AS "customerName", so.order_status AS "orderStatus", so.shipment_status AS "shipmentStatus" FROM sales_order so JOIN business_partner bp ON bp.partner_id = so.customer_id ORDER BY so.sales_order_id DESC

SELECT so.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_no AS "orderNo", bp.partner_name AS "customerName", so.order_status AS "orderStatus", so.shipment_status AS "shipmentStatus" FROM sales_order so JOIN business_partner bp ON bp.partner_id = so.customer_id WHERE so.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId}
SELECT soi.product_unit_id AS "productUnitId", soi.ordered_qty AS "orderedQty" FROM sales_order_item soi WHERE soi.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} ORDER BY soi.line_no
